Aspera Connect — phone install (simple)
=======================================

Goal: NO USB cable, NO Developer Options, NO USB debugging.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
BEST (company) — Google Play Internal testing
--------------------------------------------------------------------
IT publishes once (see docs/PLAY-STORE-INTERNAL.md).
Employees: open invite link → Install from Play Store.
Zero Play Protect drama.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY (sideload, still no USB)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
On the PHONE browser, open:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ramchandragada/asperaconnect@cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/website/phone.html

Or scan the "Get phone app" QR on the PC Aspera Connect window.

1. Tap Download Aspera Connect
2. Open the APK → allow Install unknown apps for Chrome (once)
3. Install → open app → should show v0.3.10
4. Start for calls → Scan PC QR on the PC

If Play Protect shows "More details" → "Install anyway": use that.

If Play Protect shows ONLY "OK" (hard block):
  Sideload will keep failing on this phone.
  Use Google Play Internal testing (above) — do NOT waste time on USB.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
USB (IT emergency only — not for employees)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
See INSTALL-PHONE-USB.txt
